caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized shapes and patterns on a textured beige background designed to appear aged. At the top is a gold cross with a dark red outline and light blue accent lines, flanked by mirrored gold rays. Below the cross are two gold wings, each tipped with dark red at the ends, and a stylized bow-like figure made up of four elongated, teardrop-shaped loops outlined in blue with a red and gold interior. The center of this bow is a small blue and gold circle with a red outline. Beneath the wings and bow is a large, circular medallion with a concentric design; the outer circle is bordered in dark red and blue, inside of which is a pattern of gold, red, and blue geometric shapes resembling petals or rays radiating from a central point, with inner rings alternating in these three colors. Each element is flat, with solid fills and without shading.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
